string.text: Application of a special coating decreases barrel wear.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Significantly shortened barrel cuts weight, increases mobility and pellet spread, reduces effective range and accuracy.
Without a stock the rifle is noticeably maintenance, increasing mobility, at the expense of higher recoil.
Softer recoil pad with better shock-absorption improves handling.
Weaver rail allows installation of a scope with the right mounting bracket.
More durable parts reduce weapon wear.
Barrel rifling increases muzzle velocity and accuracy, however makes the use of buckshot impossible.
